observations.title: Session summary
observations.content:
## Goal
Review the current Portfolio-Astro-refactor repository and identify any pending tasks.

## Instructions
- Respond in Spanish with concise, evidence-based findings.
- Do not modify the repository during the review.

## Discoveries
- Branch `refactor/neovim-experience` points at the same commit as `main`/`origin/main`; the working tree contains an active uncommitted refactor plus a staged deletion.
- `pnpm build` passes and generates the current site. `pnpm astro check` cannot run because `@astrojs/check` and `typescript` are not installed; no test/lint/check scripts are configured.
- No explicit TODO/FIXME/WIP backlog or planning artifacts were found.
- Static review found likely runtime blockers in `src/components/VimHeader.astro`: `/aA-zZ/` is not a letter-character regex, so command input will not accept normal keys; `setDarkMode` and `setLightMode` are referenced but not implemented.
- i18n has concrete mismatches: `KnowledgeSection.astro` uses `Techonologies` while JSON uses `Technologies`; `Projects.astro` uses project `Videogame` while JSON uses `VideoGames`; Desktop requests `TitleDescription` but that key is absent; Web and VideoGames feature headings are hardcoded. Language storage/document `lang` handling is incomplete.
- README remains the Astro starter template, favicon is generic, dependency `@justinribeiro/lite-youtube` is unused, and several assets appear orphaned.
- `.pi/work/ide-inspections/...`, `.claude/`, and `scratchpad-notifications-seed.sql` are local/generated/foreign artifacts that need an explicit keep/remove decision before commit.

## Accomplished
- ✅ Inspected Git status, branch/history, diff, source/config/localization files, and planning markers.
- ✅ Delegated read-only repository exploration to `gentle-ai-explore`.
- ✅ Delegated build/check verification to `gentle-ai-verify`.
- ✅ Recorded findings in project memory.

## Next Steps
- Prioritize fixing Vim command input and missing handlers.
- Normalize i18n keys/attributes and test both language paths in a browser.
- Decide which local artifacts belong in the refactor, then clean the working tree.
- Optionally add Astro type-check tooling and a minimal verification script/CI.

## Relevant Files
- `src/components/VimHeader.astro` — command mode, language switching, CV action.
- `src/components/Projects.astro` and `src/components/KnowledgeSection.astro` — i18n attribute mismatches.
- `public/Languages/en.json`, `public/Languages/es.json` — translation dictionaries.
- `README.md`, `package.json` — documentation and verification tooling gaps.
